Question Choices: Fill: A line that divides a shape into two matching halves is called a line of ________. (symmetry or rotation)
Hints: A symmetry line must reflect the entire shape exactly onto itself.
Solution: A line of symmetry divides the shape into two mirror-image halves that coincide exactly when folded along that line.

Question Choices: Select. Use ideal upright capital letters with uniform strokes and no serifs. O is an oval with no opening or tail; L has a left vertical post and bottom arm; P and B have a left vertical post with rounded loops only on its right. Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry? ~~L | O | P | B~~
Hints: Reflect the whole letter across its vertical centre line. Both halves must match exactly.
Solution: The left and right halves of the oval O match across its vertical centre line. L, P and B fail this test: their left post would reflect to a right post that is not present. Therefore O is the only answer.

Question Choices: Select. Which shape has MORE than one line of symmetry?: ~~A | B | C | D~~
Hints: Test vertical, horizontal and diagonal folds. A non-square rectangle has two; a square has four.
Solution: The pictured square B has 4 symmetry lines:vertical,horizontal and 2 diagonals. A is scalene, C is a non-isosceles right triangle andD a slanted non-rhombus parallelogram, so none has more than one.

Question Choices: Select the shape that has exactly two lines of symmetry -one vertical and one horizontal. When you fold it along either line, both halves match.: ~~Rectangle | Circle | Right-triangle | Pentagon~~ For the Rectangle option, use a non-square rectangle with unequal adjacent sides.
Hints: Test vertical, horizontal and diagonal folds. A non-square rectangle has two; a square has four.
Solution: A non-square rectangle has vertical and horizontal mirror lines through its centre, but its diagonals fail. A circle has infinitely many; a right triangle has at most 1; a regular pentagon has 5.

Question Choices: Fill: A regular hexagon (all sides and angles equal) has ________ lines of symmetry.
Hints: A regular polygon has the same number of symmetry lines as sides.
Solution: A regular 6-sided polygon has 6 reflection axes. Count each complete mirror line once, so the answer is 6.

Question Choices: Select. Use ideal upright capital letters with uniform strokes and no serifs. H has equal vertical posts joined at their midpoints; A has equal sloping sides and a centred horizontal crossbar; T has a centred vertical post below its top bar; P has a left post and a rounded upper loop on its right. Which letter has exactly two lines of symmetry, one vertical and one horizontal? ~~H | A | P | T~~
Hints: Test vertical and horizontal reflections separately.
Solution: H matches across its vertical centre line because its posts are equal. It also matches across its horizontal centre line because its crossbar joins the post midpoints. A and T match only vertically; P matches neither way. H has exactly two reflection lines.

Question Choices: Select. A shape has no lines of symmetry. Which of these could it be?: ~~A | B | C | D~~
Hints: A symmetry line must reflect the entire shape exactly onto itself.
Solution: A is scalene: its three sides differ, so no reflection exchanges matching sides. B (square)has 4 lines,C(isosceles triangle)has 1 vertical line,D(circle)has infinitely many.

Question Choices: Select. A shape has exactly one vertical line of symmetry but no horizontal line of symmetry.: ~~A | B | C | D~~
Hints: A symmetry line must reflect the entire shape exactly onto itself.
Solution: The isosceles triangle C has equal sloping sides that exchange under vertical reflection. Its top vertex and bottom base do not exchange under horizontal reflection. A has 0,B has 4,D infinitely many.

Question Choices: Fill: This shape has exactly  5 lines of symmetry. It is a polygon, and all its sides and angles are equal. This shape must be a  ________. (triangle or square or pentagon or hexagon)
Hints: A regular polygon has the same number of symmetry lines as sides.
Solution: A regular polygon has one reflection axis per side. Five axes imply five sides: a regular pentagon. Triangle,square,hexagon give 3,4,6.

Question Choices: True or False: Every line that passes through the center of a circle is a line of symmetry.
Hints: Every line through a circle centre reflects its boundary onto itself.
Solution: Any line through the centre is a diameter and reflects the circle onto itself. There are infinitely many such symmetry lines.
